name: Putnok (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Putnok (a crowned blue shield with an arm holding a sabre, supported by two yellow lions) above the name PUTNOK in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Putnok arms with crown and lion supporters
